usage: The word '膊頭' refers to the shoulders, a part of the human body.
You can use '膊頭' to talk about feeling pain or tension in the shoulders.
It is a noun, so it typically follows a measure word or appears as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can combine '膊頭' with verbs like '痛' (hurt), '甩' (dislocate), or '抬' (lift) to form natural sentences.
When referring to multiple people’s shoulders, you often use a measure word like '對' (pair) before '膊頭'.
